sentences.en: From the New York Times, this is the interview.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》出品的《采访》节目。

sentences.en: I'm Lulu Garcia Navarro.
sentences.zh: 我是露露·加西亚·纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: And this week I'm interviewing Whitney Wolfherd, the founder and CEO of the dating app Bumble.
sentences.zh: 本周我采访的是约会软件Bumble的创始人兼首席执行官惠特尼·沃尔夫赫德。

sentences.en: Now, when I started dating, the apps weren't an option.
sentences.zh: 我开始约会的时候，还没有这些软件。

sentences.en: I met my husband the good old-fashioned way through his ex-girlfriend.
sentences.zh: 我通过老派的方式认识了我丈夫，是通过他前女友介绍的。

sentences.en: But I wanted to talk to Wolfherd because her story really maps onto our culture's fraught relationship with technology and female business leaders.
sentences.zh: 但我之所以想和沃尔夫赫德谈谈，是因为她的故事真实地映射了我们文化中与科技和女性商业领袖之间那种紧张的关系。

sentences.en: In 2012, Wolfherd was just out of college when she co-founded Tinder, the dating app that was squarely aimed at her generation of millennials.
sentences.zh: 2012年，沃尔夫赫德刚大学毕业就联合创立了Tinder，这款约会软件的目标群体正是她那一代千禧一代。

sentences.en: Tinder gamified finding love, introducing that addictive swipe feature.
sentences.zh: Tinder将寻找爱情游戏化，引入了那个令人上瘾的滑动功能。

sentences.en: But Wolfherd went on to have a messy breakup with Tinder.
sentences.zh: 但沃尔夫赫德后来与Tinder闹得不欢而散。

sentences.en: In 2014, she left the company and sued them, alleging that she'd experienced sexual harassment
sentences.zh: 2014年，她离开了公司并起诉了他们，声称自己遭受了性骚扰，

sentences.en: and discrimination from one of her co-founders with whom she'd also had a relationship.
sentences.zh: 以及来自她的一位联合创始人的歧视，而她也曾与此人有过一段恋情。

sentences.en: The company denied responsibility and they settled the case.
sentences.zh: 公司否认了责任，双方最终达成了和解。

sentences.en: Soon after, though, at only age 25, she started Bumble, which billed itself as this safe space for women to find love, where they made the first move.
sentences.zh: 不过不久之后，年仅25岁的她就创办了Bumble，将其定位为女性寻找爱情的安全空间，在这里由女性主动出击。

sentences.en: Wolfherd then became a darling of the so-called girlboss era, when women were making real strides as leaders in tech.
sentences.zh: 沃尔夫赫德随后成为了所谓“职场女强人”时代的宠儿，当时女性在科技领域作为领导者取得了真正的进步。

sentences.en: Cut to today.
sentences.zh: 转眼到了今天。

sentences.en: Our love affair with dating apps is dying.
sentences.zh: 我们对约会软件的热恋正在消退。

sentences.en: Post-pandemic and with Gen Z very much wanting IRL connection, Bumble shares have taken a tumble, and female tech leaders like Wolfherd are even more rare than when she began.
sentences.zh: 疫情之后，随着Z世代非常渴望现实生活中的连接，Bumble的股价大幅下跌，而像沃尔夫赫德这样的女性科技领袖比她刚开始时更加罕见。

sentences.en: So after stepping down as Bumble's CEO just last year, Wolfherd is back at the company as of March with a plan to turn its fortunes around.
sentences.zh: 因此，在去年卸任Bumble首席执行官后，沃尔夫赫德已于3月回归公司，并计划扭转其颓势。

sentences.en: It involves Silicon Valley's latest transformative technology, AI, a broader vision for the app beyond dating, and some perspective on what tech can and can't do for us.
sentences.zh: 这涉及硅谷最新的变革性技术——人工智能，对该应用超越约会功能的更广泛愿景，以及对科技能为我们做什么和不能做什么的一些看法。

sentences.en: Here's my interview with Bumble founder and CEO, Whitney Wolfherd.
sentences.zh: 以下是我对Bumble创始人兼首席执行官惠特尼·沃尔夫赫德的采访。

sentences.en: Whitney, thank you so much for joining us today.
sentences.zh: 惠特尼，非常感谢你今天加入我们。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请。

sentences.en: You just stepped back into your role as CEO of Bumble in March after being away for more than a year, I think.
sentences.zh: 我想你离开了一年多，今年3月又重新担任了Bumble的首席执行官。

sentences.en: You've been in tech, though, since your early 20s, and I'm wondering what it was like in that time away because you haven't had a break.
sentences.zh: 不过你从20多岁起就一直从事科技行业，我很好奇你离开的那段时间是怎样的，因为你之前从未休息过。

sentences.en: It was amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: The time off was incredible.
sentences.zh: 那段休息时间简直不可思议。

sentences.en: It was the first time I was faced with who am I without one of these huge consumer brands attached to me, and that's a very strange place to be.
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次面对这样一个问题：没有这些巨大的消费品牌加持，我是谁？这是一种非常陌生的感觉。

sentences.en: If you think about it, I was 22 years old when we were starting Tinder, and then I became the Tinder girl.
sentences.zh: 如果你想想看，我22岁时开始做Tinder，然后我就成了“Tinder女孩”。

sentences.en: And then I became the Tinder lawsuit girl, and then I became the Bumble girl, and this became an extension of my identity.
sentences.zh: 后来我成了“Tinder诉讼女孩”，再后来成了“Bumble女孩”，这成了我身份的延伸。

sentences.en: I am the type of founder, CEO who is in every detail.
sentences.zh: 我属于那种事必躬亲的创始人兼首席执行官。

sentences.en: I'm emailing members who are having bad experiences personally.
sentences.zh: 我会亲自给那些有糟糕体验的用户发邮件。

sentences.en: And so to relinquish that level of involvement took maturity I didn't know I possessed.
sentences.zh: 所以，要放弃那种程度的参与，需要我当时并不具备的成熟度。

sentences.en: It took a level of release of control that I didn't know I was capable of.
sentences.zh: 这需要一种我当时不知道自己是否具备的放权能力。

sentences.en: And so it was very, very destabilizing at first when I stepped away because I was like, who am I without all of this?
sentences.zh: 所以刚离开时，我感到非常非常不安，因为我在想：没有了这一切，我是谁？

sentences.en: And when I left Bumble, it was tough because it didn't play out the way I'd maybe hoped in terms of the narrative.
sentences.zh: 当我离开Bumble时，过程很艰难，因为事情的发展并没有像我所希望的那样被叙述。

sentences.en: And for somebody who has been building a consumer brand and has been in the public eye to some degree, narratives can hurt.
sentences.zh: 对于一个一直在打造消费品牌并处于公众视野中的人来说，叙事方式是会伤人的。

sentences.en: Explain to me what the narrative was that you were unhappy with.
sentences.zh: 跟我解释一下，让你不满的叙事是什么样的？

sentences.en: And stock was down at the time, who knows, 80%.
sentences.zh: 当时股价下跌了，谁知道呢，80%吧。

sentences.en: So the world was seeing that as a failure.
sentences.zh: 所以全世界都将其视为一种失败。

sentences.en: So here was 10 years of what was a lot of progress.
sentences.zh: 而这可是10年来取得的巨大进步。

sentences.en: I mean, it's a billion dollar revenue business.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一家营收达十亿美元的企业。

sentences.en: It's a big company.
sentences.zh: 这是一家大公司。

sentences.en: It's a brand that is global at this point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个目前已全球化的品牌。

sentences.en: So in my mind, I was stepping away from something that I had seen as so much bigger than where it was when we started objectively and to have it reduced down to,
sentences.zh: 所以在我的心目中，我离开的是一个我亲眼见证它比刚开始时客观上强大得多的东西，却被简化为，

sentences.en: oh, she failed.
sentences.zh: 哦，她失败了。

sentences.en: She must have been kicked out.
sentences.zh: 她一定是被踢出来的。

sentences.en: I mean, there was so much fodder around why I was leaving and it hurt my feelings.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于我为什么要离开，有太多的流言蜚语，这伤害了我的感情。

sentences.en: What was the real reason you left?
sentences.zh: 你离开的真正原因是什么？

sentences.en: I was exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我精疲力竭。

sentences.en: I was completely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我彻底筋疲力尽了。

sentences.en: I wanted to see my children.
sentences.zh: 我想见我的孩子们。

sentences.en: I wanted to get still in my own mind.
sentences.zh: 我想让自己的内心平静下来。

sentences.en: And I just needed a break.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要休息一下。

sentences.en: I wanted to see my mom.
sentences.zh: 我想见我的妈妈。

sentences.en: I wanted to see my husband.
sentences.zh: 我想见我的丈夫。

sentences.en: I wanted to be with friends.
sentences.zh: 我想和朋友们在一起。

sentences.en: I just needed to take a breather.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要喘口气。

sentences.en: I guess that leads me to the question of why you came back.
sentences.zh: 我想这引出了你为什么回来的问题。

sentences.en: Because you are coming back at a high stakes moment for the company.
sentences.zh: 因为你是在公司处于高风险时刻回来的。

sentences.en: As you mentioned, Bumble stock price has been on a low, steady decline.
sentences.zh: 正如你所提到的，Bumble的股价一直在低位稳步下跌。

sentences.en: It's about $4.
sentences.zh: 大约4美元左右。

sentences.en: You've announced a rebrand, which we're going to get to.
sentences.zh: 你宣布了品牌重塑，我们稍后会谈到。

sentences.en: But big picture, what drew you back to the company?
sentences.zh: 但从大局来看，是什么吸引你回到公司？

sentences.en: I had no intentions of coming back.
sentences.zh: 我根本没打算回来。

sentences.en: I mean, here I am.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你看我现在。

sentences.en: I'm just in the groove of being this kind of removed founder.
sentences.zh: 我正沉浸在作为这种“退居幕后”创始人的状态中。

sentences.en: I was meditating every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都在冥想。

sentences.en: I was really working on these inward practices.
sentences.zh: 我真的在进行这些内在的修行。

sentences.en: But very still involved.
sentences.zh: 但依然参与其中。

sentences.en: I mean, all the board calls.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，所有的董事会电话会议我都会参加。

sentences.en: But I'm not running the show.
sentences.zh: 但我不是在掌舵。

sentences.en: And I had a phone call with my prior CEO, who I still think the world of.
sentences.zh: 我和我之前的首席执行官通了电话，我依然非常敬重她。

sentences.en: This is Lydiani Jones, who had come over from Slack to take over Bumble.
sentences.zh: 这就是莉迪亚尼·琼斯，她从Slack跳槽过来接管Bumble。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And she's an amazing woman.
sentences.zh: 她是一位了不起的女性。

sentences.en: We're on very, very good terMs.
sentences.zh: 我们关系非常好。

sentences.en: I think the world wants people, particularly when it's a woman to a woman, they want there to be some rift.
sentences.zh: 我认为全世界都希望人们之间，特别是当涉及到女性对女性时，希望她们之间存在某种裂痕。

sentences.en: There's no rift.
sentences.zh: 根本没有裂痕。

sentences.en: She and I got on a call, and she let me know that it wasn't working for her anymore.
sentences.zh: 她和我通了电话，她告诉我她已经无法胜任这份工作了。

sentences.en: And I think she'd burned herself out.
sentences.zh: 我想她也把自己累垮了。

sentences.en: And I felt so deeply for her because I felt like I was looking in a mirror.
sentences.zh: 我非常同情她，因为我觉得自己就像在照镜子。

sentences.en: I felt like I was looking at myself a year prior.
sentences.zh: 我觉得自己就像在看一年前的自己。

sentences.en: However, I could tell that she was exhausted and that she herself had made some of the same mistakes I had made, which was working that extra hour, putting in that extra trip.
sentences.zh: 然而，我能看出她精疲力竭，而且她自己也犯了一些我曾经犯过的错误，比如多工作一小时，多出一次差。

sentences.en: So you can imagine what was going through my mind.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象我当时在想什么。

sentences.en: Am I going back?
sentences.zh: 我要回去吗？

sentences.en: Who's going to run this company?
sentences.zh: 谁来经营这家公司？

sentences.en: And ultimately, I felt like even if it's not what I necessarily would have signed up for willingly, I felt like it was happening for me.
sentences.zh: 最终，我觉得即使这不是我必然会主动选择的事情，我也觉得这是命中注定的。

sentences.en: I did feel like, oh, this is happening for a reason.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得，哦，这一切发生是有原因的。

sentences.en: Bumble needs me back.
sentences.zh: Bumble需要我回来。

sentences.en: It's an extension of me to some degree.
sentences.zh: 它在某种程度上是我自己的延伸。

sentences.en: And watching it fall from its peak has been very hard.
sentences.zh: 看着它从巅峰跌落，我感到非常难过。

sentences.en: And I did feel this is a bit of a crazy story.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得这是一个有点疯狂的故事。

sentences.en: I had this strange epiphany a week before she quit where it's like, oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 在她辞职前一周，我有一种奇怪的顿悟，当时我就想，天哪。

sentences.en: My life's work was to help people get closer to love.
sentences.zh: 我毕生的工作就是帮助人们更接近爱情。

sentences.en: And I literally, because I'm, you know, I love Oprah and I love everything she talks about.
sentences.zh: 我真的，因为我，你知道，我喜欢奥普拉，我喜欢她谈论的一切。

sentences.en: I had been doing her exercise of don't tell the universe what you want.
sentences.zh: 我一直在做她的练习：不要告诉宇宙你想要什么。

sentences.en: Tell the universe to use you what it needs from you.
sentences.zh: 告诉宇宙去使用你，去完成它需要你做的事情。

sentences.en: And so I'd been like, just use me for love.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直在说，就为了爱而使用我吧。

sentences.en: Just use me for love and light.
sentences.zh: 就为了爱与光明而使用我吧。

sentences.en: And she left a few days later.
sentences.zh: 几天后她就离开了。

sentences.en: And so I was like, I've got to go back in.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时想，我必须回去。

sentences.en: And I kind of just raised my hand to the board and said, listen, I'd like to put my hat back in the ring.
sentences.zh: 我向董事会举手示意，说：听着，我想重新参与竞争。

sentences.en: The board could have chosen not to put me back in.
sentences.zh: 董事会本可以选择不让我回来。

sentences.en: The board did their diligence.
sentences.zh: 董事会进行了尽职调查。

sentences.en: They convened.
sentences.zh: 他们召开了会议。

sentences.en: And they called me and said, we'd like to have you back if you'll do it.
sentences.zh: 他们打电话给我说：如果你愿意，我们希望你回来。

sentences.en: We're going to talk a lot more about your plans for the company.
sentences.zh: 我们还要多谈谈你对公司的计划。

sentences.en: But I do want to start by going back because your trajectory has been so fascinating when you started Bumble.
sentences.zh: 但我确实想先回顾一下过去，因为当你创办Bumble时，你的轨迹非常引人入胜。

sentences.en: And you mentioned this.
sentences.zh: 你也提到了这一点。

sentences.en: In 2014, you recently left Tinder.
sentences.zh: 2014年，你刚离开Tinder。

sentences.en: And the big difference between Bumble and other dating apps was women had to send the first message, right?
sentences.zh: Bumble与其他约会软件的最大区别在于女性必须发送第一条消息，对吧？

sentences.en: That was like the big innovation of Bumble.
sentences.zh: 那就像是Bumble的重大创新。

sentences.en: And media at the time called it feminist Tinder.
sentences.zh: 当时的媒体称它为“女权主义Tinder”。

sentences.en: Is that how you saw it back then?
sentences.zh: 你当时是这样看的吗？

sentences.en: So I didn't think about the word feminist or feminism back then.
sentences.zh: 那时我并没有考虑“女权主义”或“女性主义”这个词。

sentences.en: You have to remember, I did not come out of a liberal arts college somewhere in the Northeast where it was super progressive.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，我并不是从东北部某所超级进步的文理学院毕业的。

sentences.en: I was at SMU in Dallas, Texas for college.
sentences.zh: 我是在德克萨斯州达拉斯的南卫理公会大学读的大学。

sentences.en: I then ended up in a, would not say extremely feminist tech environment.
sentences.zh: 后来我进入了一个，我不会说是一个极其女权主义的科技环境。

sentences.en: And I was 22 and then 23 and then 24 years old in a time that was before me too, before Time's Up, before this was, you know, I call it the pre-Pink Target era.
sentences.zh: 我当时22岁，然后是23岁，24岁，那是在“我也是”运动之前，在“时代已到”运动之前，在这一切之前，你知道，我称之为“前粉色目标”时代。

sentences.en: Do you know what I'm talking about?
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么吗？

sentences.en: Where this was before Target started selling all the girl power t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 那时是在Target开始销售所有那些“女孩力量”T恤之前。

sentences.en: Feminism had not gone mainstream.
sentences.zh: 女权主义还没有成为主流。

sentences.en: I didn't wake up and see some marketing opportunity to go build a feminist this or a feminist that.
sentences.zh: 我并没有醒来后发现什么营销机会去打造一个女权主义这个或女权主义那个。

sentences.en: None of it was an angle.
sentences.zh: 这一切都不是为了噱头。

sentences.en: It was genuinely a real lived experience where I felt that as a young woman who had dated, I did not feel like an equal.
sentences.zh: 这确实是我真实的生活经历，作为一个约会过的年轻女性，我觉得自己没有得到平等的对待。

sentences.en: I felt like women had to wait for men to choose them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得女性必须等待男性的选择。

sentences.en: You couldn't text a guy first in college.
sentences.zh: 在大学里，你不能先给男生发短信。

sentences.en: You were considered crazy, desperate.
sentences.zh: 你当时被认为是个疯子，是个走投无路的人。

sentences.en: So this was just my natural environment.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我来说只是自然环境而已。

sentences.en: It's not like I was sitting around saying, oh, how do I come up with a new angle at Tinder as some revenge plot?
sentences.zh: 我并不是坐在那儿琢磨，哦，我该怎么在 Tinder 搞出一个新花样来作为某种复仇计划？

sentences.en: That's not what happened.
sentences.zh: 事情并不是那样发生的。

sentences.en: What happened was I just built a solution to the problems myself and my friends had.
sentences.zh: 事实是，我只是为我和朋友们遇到的问题建立了一个解决方案。

sentences.en: And then, of course, media and everybody else said, oh, it's feminist and it's this and it's girl power.
sentences.zh: 然后，当然了，媒体和其他所有人就说，哦，这是女权主义，这是什么什么，这是女性力量。

sentences.en: And I kind of was like, well, yeah, I mean, look at the definition.
sentences.zh: 我当时就觉得，嗯，好吧，我的意思是，看看定义就知道了。

sentences.en: I guess you could technically call it feminist if you wanted to because it's about trying to level the playing field.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你愿意的话，从技术上讲你可以称之为女权主义，因为它旨在努力创造一个公平的竞争环境。

sentences.en: I mean, it's interesting because there's always been this narrative around you, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这很有趣，因为围绕你一直有这样一种叙事，对吧？

sentences.en: This was the girl boss era when you started.
sentences.zh: 你刚起步的时候正是“女老板”（girl boss）时代。

sentences.en: You were one of its best known figures, a woman in her 20s leading the successful company.
sentences.zh: 你是其中最知名的代表人物之一，一位二十多岁领导着成功公司的女性。

sentences.en: And I'm curious how the term girl boss sat with you at the time.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇当时“女老板”这个词对你来说意味着什么。

sentences.en: And if you look back on it any differently now.
sentences.zh: 以及你现在回看它时是否有不同的看法。

sentences.en: It's so funny.
sentences.zh: 这太搞笑了。

sentences.en: I don't know how to properly answer this because for me, I do remember vividly being at Tinder and having Sophia's book, Girl Boss.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该怎么恰当地回答这个问题，因为我确实清晰地记得在 Tinder 工作时，我手里有索菲亚（Sophia）的那本《女老板》（Girl Boss）。

sentences.en: You're talking about Sophia Amoroso who wrote the book, Girl Boss.
sentences.zh: 你指的是写了《女老板》那本书的索菲亚·阿莫鲁索（Sophia Amoruso）。

sentences.en: And I do remember feeling inspired.
sentences.zh: 我确实记得当时感到很受鼓舞。

sentences.en: Like, oh, wow, look what she's done.
sentences.zh: 就像是，哦，哇，看看她做到了什么。

sentences.en: I had never seen any representation of a woman building something before.
sentences.zh: 我以前从未见过女性创业的先例。

sentences.en: I just had never seen it.
sentences.zh: 我真的从未见过。

sentences.en: And now, of course, you had the greats at the time, which were Sheryl Sandberg.
sentences.zh: 当然，现在你有了当时的那些大人物，比如谢丽尔·桑德伯格（Sheryl Sandberg）。

sentences.en: But again, she was a COO.
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，她是个首席运营官（COO）。

sentences.en: It wasn't, you know, a woman that had founded the business.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那并不是一位创立了这家企业的女性。

sentences.en: I love Sheryl.
sentences.zh: 我爱谢丽尔。

sentences.en: I think she's amazing.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她很了不起。

sentences.en: And so at the time, I just thought the girl boss narrative was fine.
sentences.zh: 所以当时，我只是觉得“女老板”这种叙事没什么问题。

sentences.en: And then somewhere along the line, somewhere along the years, 2016, 2017, 2018, this girl boss arc just turned dark.
sentences.zh: 然后随着时间的推移，在 2016、2017、2018 年左右，这个“女老板”的弧线开始变得阴暗了。

sentences.en: I don't really know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我真的不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: See, again, I was in such a tunnel building this company.
sentences.zh: 你看，再说一次，我当时一心扑在建立这家公司上。

sentences.en: However, I watched a lot of my peers fall.
sentences.zh: 然而，我看着很多同行倒下了。

sentences.en: A lot.
sentences.zh: 很多。

sentences.en: My era, which sounds like we're talking about something 600 years ago, a few years back.
sentences.zh: 我的那个时代——听起来好像我们在谈论 600 年前的事，其实也就几年前。

sentences.en: You're in your early 30s.
sentences.zh: 你现在才三十出头。
我 35 岁。

sentences.en: To be clear.
sentences.zh: 声明一下。

sentences.en: So this was like 2016 through, call it, 19.
sentences.zh: 所以那大概是 2016 年到 2019 年吧。

sentences.en: That era was all about the young woman who was building something.
sentences.zh: 那个时代的主题全是关于年轻女性在创业。

sentences.en: And then it was about just taking her down.
sentences.zh: 然后主题就变成了如何把她拉下马。

sentences.en: And it paralyzed me.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到瘫痪。

sentences.en: I'll never forget, Bloomberg came.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记，彭博社（Bloomberg）来了。

sentences.en: I was pregnant with my first child.
sentences.zh: 当时我怀着第一个孩子。

sentences.en: Bloomberg came to follow along as we passed a law for cyber flashing to create, you know,
sentences.zh: 彭博社来跟拍我们推动一项关于“网络闪露”（cyber flashing）的法律，以建立，你知道的，

sentences.en: protections online for women because we were seeing that so many women were being subjected to unsolicited lewd behavior and images.
sentences.zh: 为女性提供在线保护，因为我们看到太多女性正遭受未经请求的淫秽行为和图片的骚扰。

sentences.en: And we were doing our best to try to try to create some accountability.
sentences.zh: 我们正在尽最大努力尝试建立某种问责机制。

sentences.en: And this was in Texas, which eventually that law passed.
sentences.zh: 这发生在德克萨斯州，最终那项法律通过了。

sentences.en: The law passed.
sentences.zh: 法律通过了。

sentences.en: And so we brought the reporter with us to the Capitol and to testify.
sentences.zh: 所以我们带着记者一起去了州议会大厦进行作证。

sentences.en: And in my mind, we were just following along.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，我们只是在履行职责。

sentences.en: The article came out and the headline was some version of Bumble's not feminiSt.
sentences.zh: 文章出来了，标题大概是“Bumble 不是女权主义”。

sentences.en: It's just feminist marketing.
sentences.zh: “这只是女权主义营销”。

sentences.en: And it sent me into a very dark place because I felt like I could do nothing right.
sentences.zh: 这让我陷入了非常黑暗的境地，因为我觉得自己做什么都不对。

sentences.en: Here I was doing my best to run a company and pass a law to try my best to make this safer for women online.
sentences.zh: 我当时在尽我所能经营一家公司，并推动一项法律，试图让女性在网上更安全。

sentences.en: And even doing that, well, a lot of the, not to be disrespectful, but a lot of the male tech CEOs are not trying to pass laws to make the Internet safer, right?
sentences.zh: 即使是做这些，好吧，很多——不是不尊重——但很多男性科技公司首席执行官并没有试图通过法律让互联网更安全，对吧？

sentences.en: So I just felt like, oh, this is what happens to you when you're a woman CEO.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是觉得，哦，这就是当你成为女性首席执行官时会发生的事情。

sentences.en: You can't survive.
sentences.zh: 你无法幸存。

sentences.en: You will be scrutinized.
sentences.zh: 你会受到严密审视。

sentences.en: You will be taken down.
sentences.zh: 你会被拉下马。

sentences.en: And I think that was the beginning of the end of me feeling confident in what I was doing.
sentences.zh: 我认为那是我对自己所做的事情失去信心的开始。

sentences.en: I think that the culture now looks at Sheryl Sandberg, the lean-in era, and that moment with a lot more skepticism.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在的文化以更怀疑的眼光看待谢丽尔·桑德伯格、“向前一步”（lean-in）时代以及那个时刻。

sentences.en: And there is this idea of what is performative and what is actually the structural challenges that women face.
sentences.zh: 人们开始思考什么是表演性的，什么是女性在前进过程中真正面临的结构性挑战。

sentences.en: Totally.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: To get ahead.
sentences.zh: 为了取得成功。

sentences.en: Are people taking advantage of zeitgeist or are they actually trying to change fundamental underlying things that make it difficult?
sentences.zh: 人们是在利用时代精神，还是真的在试图改变那些造成困难的根本性潜在因素？

sentences.en: I think this is where I struggled during those years.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我在那些年里挣扎的地方。

sentences.en: I think what became a challenge for me was I felt like anything I did would just auto-get labeled back to this woman CEO.
sentences.zh: 我认为对我来说成为挑战的是，我感觉我所做的任何事情都会自动被贴上“女性首席执行官”的标签。

sentences.en: She must be a faker.
sentences.zh: 她一定是个骗子。

sentences.en: She must be a this.
sentences.zh: 她一定是这样。

sentences.en: She must be a that.
sentences.zh: 她一定是那样。

sentences.en: And it just felt like you couldn't catch a breath during that chapter,
sentences.zh: 在那段时期，感觉你连喘口气的机会都没有，

sentences.en: which the reason why I bring any of this up is I think it led to the depletion that I faced three years after being a public company CEO with all of those challenges.
sentences.zh: 我提起这些的原因是，我认为这导致了我在担任上市公司首席执行官三年后，面对所有这些挑战时所经历的精疲力竭。

sentences.en: Where I was like, I can't do this anymore.
sentences.zh: 当时我就想，我再也做不下去了。

sentences.en: I have to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我必须离开这里。

sentences.en: And by the way, the other thing we do need to touch on, Bloomberg probably was not entirely wrong.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，我们需要触及的另一件事是，彭博社可能并不完全是错的。

sentences.en: Bumble's not perfect.
sentences.zh: Bumble 并不完美。

sentences.en: Nor was it perfect then.
sentences.zh: 当时也不完美。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 它现在也不完美。

sentences.en: Women have been treated very badly on Bumble.
sentences.zh: 女性在 Bumble 上受到了非常糟糕的对待。

sentences.en: I actually think that there are times where we have overshot the benefit to women in a marketing moment or whatever that is than what we've actually been able to do.
sentences.zh: 我实际上认为，有时我们在营销时刻对女性的益处上夸大其词了，超出了我们实际能够做到的程度。

sentences.en: I think my point back to the Bloomberg moment was that it felt like that was just another gotcha attempt in this culture of which CEO that's a young woman can we go get next?
sentences.zh: 我想我回到彭博社那个时刻的观点是，感觉那只是在这个文化中又一次“抓把柄”的尝试——看看下一个年轻女性首席执行官是谁，我们可以去搞定她？

sentences.en: Does that make any sense?
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗？

sentences.en: I don't feel like it was done because they authentically wanted to cover the company and they wanted to find the fair flaws and the fair benefits.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得他们这样做是因为他们真心想报道这家公司，想找出公平的缺陷和公平的益处。

sentences.en: I did feel as if it was like, oh, this is a target that hasn't fallen yet.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得这就像是，哦，这是一个还没倒下的目标。

sentences.en: Let's go get her.
sentences.zh: 让我们去搞定她。

sentences.en: I am curious when you say there were fair flaws.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，当你提到“公平的缺陷”时。

sentences.en: Like, what do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你是说那是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, a woman sending a message on an app is not going to save the world.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一个女性在应用上发送消息并不能拯救世界。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 它做不到。

sentences.en: Let's just be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我们诚实一点吧。

sentences.en: It was a small step to try and recalibrate thousands of years of power dynamics in relationships.
sentences.zh: 这只是试图重新校准数千年来关系中权力动态的一小步。

sentences.en: But yeah, I mean, maybe we've oversold ourselves along the way in certain ways, and I'm okay to say that.
sentences.zh: 但是的，我的意思是，也许我们在这一过程中在某些方面过度推销了自己，我愿意承认这一点。

sentences.en: We are a part of the problem in this bigger cultural landscape of online love.
sentences.zh: 在这个更大的在线爱情文化景观中，我们也是问题的一部分。

sentences.en: We're not perfect.
sentences.zh: 我们并不完美。

sentences.en: I am curious beyond the broader cultural moment, how you felt you were received as a young woman within the tech industry,
sentences.zh: 我很好奇，除了更广泛的文化时刻之外，你觉得作为科技行业的一名年轻女性，你受到了怎样的对待，

sentences.en: especially after your lawsuit against Tinder for sexual harassment and discrimination.
sentences.zh: 特别是在你因性骚扰和歧视起诉 Tinder 之后。

sentences.en: This is before Me Too.
sentences.zh: 那是在“我也是”（Me Too）运动之前。

sentences.en: This is before a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 那是在很多事情发生之前。

sentences.en: How did that impact you professionally?
sentences.zh: 这对你的职业生涯有什么影响？

sentences.en: Nobody wanted to associate with me.
sentences.zh: 没人想和我扯上关系。

sentences.en: Nobody wanted to work with me.
sentences.zh: 没人想和我一起工作。

sentences.en: There was only one person that was willing to give me any opportunity, and that was my former business partner.
sentences.zh: 只有一个愿意给我任何机会的人，那就是我以前的商业伙伴。

sentences.en: I kind of had to be scrappy and take whoever was willing to see past it.
sentences.zh: 我不得不变得机灵点，接受任何愿意看透这一切的人。

sentences.en: The tech, you know what it was?
sentences.zh: 科技界，你知道是怎么回事吗？

sentences.en: A lot of people outside of the tech world didn't know about this.
sentences.zh: 科技界之外的很多人并不知道这件事。

sentences.en: I didn't care.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like the world goes on.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，世界总是在继续。

sentences.en: When it comes to that tech space, oh, I was, you just don't talk to Whitney Wolfe.
sentences.zh: 当谈到科技领域时，哦，我当时的情况是，你就是别跟惠特尼·沃尔夫（Whitney Wolfe）说话。

sentences.en: Why would you ever talk to her?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要跟她说话？

sentences.en: As you mentioned, you did find an investor and a mentor in Andrei Andreev, who was the head of Badoo, and he was a co-creator of Bumble.
sentences.zh: 正如你提到的，你确实在安德烈·安德烈耶夫（Andrei Andreev）那里找到了投资者和导师，他是 Badoo 的负责人，也是 Bumble 的联合创始人。

sentences.en: And then you faced another workplace scandal after Bumble launched involving him.
sentences.zh: 然后你在 Bumble 推出后又面临了另一场涉及他的职场丑闻。

sentences.en: In 2019, Forbes published an investigation into him and the culture there.
sentences.zh: 2019 年，《福布斯》发表了一项关于他和那里文化的调查。

sentences.en: And he was accused of creating a toxic and sexist work environment at their London headquarters.
sentences.zh: 他被指控在伦敦总部创造了一种有毒且性别歧视的工作环境。

sentences.en: Now, he denied the allegations, but ended up selling his majority stake not long after the article was published.
sentences.zh: 现在，他否认了这些指控，但在文章发表后不久就卖掉了他的多数股权。

sentences.en: I don't want to get into the particulars, which have been, I think, pretty well chewed over.
sentences.zh: 我不想深入讨论那些细节，我想那些已经被讨论得够多了。

sentences.en: I think I bring it up because it is striking to me that you had to deal with a second high-profile case of alleged male bad behavior in your professional life.
sentences.zh: 我提起这件事是因为，令我震惊的是，你在职业生涯中不得不处理第二起备受瞩目的男性不当行为指控案件。

sentences.en: At the same time, you were building a company whose brand was about empowering women.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，你正在建立一家以赋权女性为品牌的公司。

sentences.en: I mean, what do you make of that now?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你现在怎么看这件事？

sentences.en: I mean, horrible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，太可怕了。

sentences.en: Like, absolutely the worst-case scenario.
sentences.zh: 绝对是最糟糕的情况。

sentences.en: I obviously felt sick for anybody that felt the way they felt.
sentences.zh: 对于任何有那种感受的人，我显然感到难受。

sentences.en: And I did not know about any of these allegations, which to a lot of people, they're like, oh, Whitney's a liar.
sentences.zh: 我不知道任何这些指控，这对很多人来说，他们会觉得，哦，惠特尼是个骗子。

sentences.en: Of course, she knew all these things, and she's covering up for this guy.
sentences.zh: 她当然知道所有这些事情，她在为这个家伙掩盖。

sentences.en: And the frank truth is, I was in Austin, running Bumble from Austin, very much as it's standalone business.
sentences.zh: 坦率的事实是，我在奥斯汀，从奥斯汀经营 Bumble，它在很大程度上是一个独立的企业。

sentences.en: It's not like I was sitting in the office all day and intersecting with those people.
sentences.zh: 我并不是整天坐在办公室里与那些人打交道。

sentences.en: And so it was gutting to me.
sentences.zh: 所以这对我来说是毁灭性的打击。

sentences.en: When Forbes called me and told me this, I was speechless.
sentences.zh: 当《福布斯》打电话告诉我这件事时，我惊呆了。

sentences.en: I was shocked.
sentences.zh: 我感到震惊。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was really important to Andre that I be honest about my personal interaction with him, which the frank truth is I had never seen anything to that degree.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，安德烈对我诚实地说明我与他的个人互动非常重要，坦率地说，我从未见过任何那种程度的事情。

sentences.en: However, I would never question a woman or another person in their experience.
sentences.zh: 然而，我永远不会质疑女性或其他人的经历。

sentences.en: And I said that.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这么说的。

sentences.en: And remember, so this is an important note for listeners.
sentences.zh: 记住，这对听众来说是一个重要的说明。

sentences.en: I believe those allegations were stemming from several years prior.
sentences.zh: 我相信这些指控源于几年前。

sentences.en: They were not active.
sentences.zh: 它们不是当时正在发生的。

sentences.en: They were talking about workplace culture from kind of the earlier Badoo era, if I remember correctly.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，他们谈论的是 Badoo 早期的一种职场文化。

sentences.en: There was a range of allegations from different times.
sentences.zh: 有来自不同时期的各种指控。

sentences.en: The article came out in 2019.
sentences.zh: 文章是 2019 年出来的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But I think the bulk of the article was covering things that had been kind of earlier days.
sentences.zh: 但我认为文章的大部分内容涵盖的是早期的那些事情。

sentences.en: So what I'm getting at, I'm not trying to recuse myself from anything.
sentences.zh: 所以我想说的是，我并不是试图推卸任何责任。

sentences.en: That's not what I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 我不是在做那种事。

sentences.en: I'm trying to say if you look at the early 2010s, I mean, we've all seen the movies, the WeWorks and the Ubers.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，如果你看看 2010 年代初期，我的意思是，我们都看过那些电影，WeWork 和 Uber 之类的。

sentences.en: And there starts to be this consistent picture of, you know, when you close your eyes and think about a tech company in 2012,
sentences.zh: 开始出现这种一致的画面，你知道，当你闭上眼睛想到 2012 年的一家科技公司时，

sentences.en: you see beer pong and you see, you know, all the men together.
sentences.zh: 你会看到啤酒乒乓球，你会看到，你知道，所有的男人聚在一起。

sentences.en: I don't think you close your eyes and think back on like a progressive office space.
sentences.zh: 我不认为你会闭上眼睛想到一个进步的办公空间。

sentences.en: What do you take away from this?
sentences.zh: 你从中得到了什么启示？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: You could call it whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 你可以随你怎么称呼它。

sentences.en: Maybe I just found myself in two of the only situations.
sentences.zh: 也许我只是发现自己处于仅有的两种情况之中。

sentences.en: The other thing about that period is that it also seems like a moment of tech optimism.
sentences.zh: 关于那个时期的另一件事是，它似乎也是一个科技乐观主义的时刻。

sentences.en: All these apps were coming out.
sentences.zh: 所有这些应用程序都在涌现。

sentences.en: They were backed by incomprehensible amounts of money.
sentences.zh: 它们背后有难以想象的巨额资金支持。

sentences.en: They promised to solve so many of the world's probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他们承诺要解决世界上那么多的问题。

sentences.en: Did you believe that back then?
sentences.zh: 你当时相信了吗？

sentences.en: Did you sort of feel like this was an incredible opportunity to really tackle things in a new way?
sentences.zh: 你是否觉得这是一个以全新方式真正解决问题的绝佳机会？

sentences.en: Yeah, I did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我当时是这么想的。

sentences.en: I did.
sentences.zh: 我确实这么想。

sentences.en: To be able to get on an app,
sentences.zh: 能够通过一个应用程序，

sentences.en: see who's around you and instantly connect with them and then all of a sudden end up on a date with someone that you would have never in a hundred years met had it not been for this interface,
sentences.zh: 看到你周围的人并立即与他们建立联系，然后突然之间，你竟然和某人约会了，而如果不是因为这个界面，你可能一百年都不会遇到他们，

sentences.en: that felt really transformational.
sentences.zh: 这感觉真的具有变革性。

sentences.en: But so did being able to order a black car on Uber.
sentences.zh: 但通过 Uber 叫一辆黑色轿车也同样具有变革性。

sentences.en: We were just at this moment.
sentences.zh: 我们当时正处于那个时刻。

sentences.en: Gosh, if any Gen Z people are listening to us right now, they're going to be like, these people, what?
sentences.zh: 天哪，如果现在有 Z 世代的人在听我们说话，他们会觉得，这些人，什么鬼？

sentences.en: Did they live in the dark ages?
sentences.zh: 他们是生活在黑暗时代吗？

sentences.en: Hey, listen, I remember the time before cell phones completely, so you know.
sentences.zh: 嘿，听着，我完全记得手机出现之前的时代，所以你懂的。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, but you know where I'm going with this.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我是说，但你明白我想表达的意思。

sentences.en: That was a huge leap in terms of efficiency and ease.
sentences.zh: 在效率和便捷性方面，那是一个巨大的飞跃。

sentences.en: And so I couldn't believe we were at the center of this as well.
sentences.zh: 所以我无法相信我们也处于这一切的中心。

sentences.en: And then, and I don't say this in a self-promotional way at all, it's really hard to do it twice.
sentences.zh: 而且，我这么说绝不是为了自我推销，要在同一件事上成功两次真的很难。

sentences.en: It's really hard to do it twice.
sentences.zh: 要在同一件事上成功两次真的很难。

sentences.en: And so many people over the years have been like, God, she's just lucky.
sentences.zh: 多年来，很多人都说，天哪，她只是运气好。

sentences.en: She wore a lot of yellow.
sentences.zh: 她穿了很多黄色衣服。

sentences.en: She's blonde.
sentences.zh: 她是金发碧眼。

sentences.en: You know, they assumed it was all these things that made it happen.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们认为正是这些因素促成了这一切。

sentences.en: But I'm not entirely sure people realize just how hard it is to get critical mass on an app twice.
sentences.zh: 但我不太确定人们是否意识到，要在同一个应用程序上两次达到临界规模有多难。

sentences.en: I mean, there are thousands and thousands of dating apps that hit the app store and none of them work.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有成千上万的约会软件出现在应用商店里，但没有一个能成功。

sentences.en: None of them scale.
sentences.zh: 没有一个能实现规模化。

sentences.en: I mean, what, there's two or three or four that have ever scaled to our degree of scale?
sentences.zh: 我是说，有什么，只有两三个或四个达到了我们这种规模？

sentences.en: The next era of Bumble, you had a lot of growth during the pandemic when everyone was stuck on their apps.
sentences.zh: Bumble 的下一个时代，在疫情期间，当每个人都被困在家里使用应用程序时，你们经历了很多增长。

sentences.en: It was a huge moment.
sentences.zh: 那是一个巨大的时刻。

sentences.en: You go public in 2021, ring the bell, baby on your hip.
sentences.zh: 你在 2021 年上市，敲响了钟，怀里还抱着孩子。

sentences.en: And the very next year, user growth starts to slow down.
sentences.zh: 而就在第二年，用户增长开始放缓。

sentences.en: What do you think was happening then?
sentences.zh: 你认为当时发生了什么？

sentences.en: Um, my opinion is that I ran this company for the first several years as a quality over quantity approach.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的观点是，我在 Bumble 运营的前几年采取的是重质量而非重数量的方法。

sentences.en: There were opportunities throughout my career at Bumble where huge scaled operations offered us.
sentences.zh: 在我的 Bumble 职业生涯中，曾多次有大型规模化运营的机会找上门来。

sentences.en: A telephone provider came to us early on in Bumble.
sentences.zh: Bumble 早期曾有一家电话运营商找到我们。

sentences.en: They said, we love your brand.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们喜欢你们的品牌。

sentences.en: And we actually want to put your app pre-programmed on all of our phones.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上想把你们的应用程序预装在我们所有的手机上。

sentences.en: And when people buy our phones, your app will be on the home screen.
sentences.zh: 当人们购买我们的手机时，你们的应用程序就会出现在主屏幕上。

sentences.en: And you're going to get millions of free downloads.
sentences.zh: 你们将获得数百万次的免费下载。

sentences.en: And I said, thank you so much, but no thank you.
sentences.zh: 我说，非常感谢，但不用了。

sentences.en: And nobody could understand what in the world I was doing.
sentences.zh: 没人能理解我到底在做什么。

sentences.en: And I said, it's the wrong way to grow.
sentences.zh: 我说，这是错误的增长方式。

sentences.en: This is not a social network.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个社交网络。

sentences.en: This is a double-sided marketplace.
sentences.zh: 这是一个双边市场。

sentences.en: One person gets on and they have to see someone that is relevant to them, that they want to see.
sentences.zh: 一个人加入进来，他们必须看到与他们相关、他们想看到的人。

sentences.en: And if you flood the system just endlessly with, you know, you're not going to go walk down the street of New York City and want to meet every single person you pass.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是无休止地用（用户）淹没系统，你知道，你走在纽约市的街道上，并不会想认识你经过的每一个人。

sentences.en: That is the truth.
sentences.zh: 这是事实。

sentences.en: So why would you assume that someone would want to do that on an app?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么你会认为有人会想在应用程序上这样做呢？

sentences.en: This is not a content platform where you can just scroll and scroll and scroll and scale drives results.
sentences.zh: 这不是一个你可以随意滚动、滚动再滚动，且靠规模驱动结果的内容平台。

sentences.en: But what happened was, in the pandemic and throughout other chapters, growth was king.
sentences.zh: 但发生的情况是，在疫情期间以及其他阶段，增长就是王道。

sentences.en: It was hailed as the end-all be-all.
sentences.zh: 它被誉为终极目标。

sentences.en: So this is like users, how many people are joining the app, engagement, etc.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像用户数、有多少人加入应用程序、参与度等等。

sentences.en: The more the merrier.
sentences.zh: 越多越好。

sentences.en: The more people here, the more money, the better.
sentences.zh: 这里的人越多，钱就越多，越好。

sentences.en: Let me put this simply.
sentences.zh: 让我简单说明一下。

sentences.en: The world started focusing, when I say the world, I mean even our team, started focusing on outputs.
sentences.zh: 世界开始关注——当我说是世界时，我是指包括我们的团队——开始关注产出。

sentences.en: What are outputs?
sentences.zh: 什么是产出？

sentences.en: Outputs are revenue growth, payers, sheer volume of registration.
sentences.zh: 产出就是收入增长、付费用户、注册的绝对数量。

sentences.en: A good business does not focus on outputs.
sentences.zh: 一家好的企业不会只关注产出。

sentences.en: A good business focuses on the core inputs that matter moSt.
sentences.zh: 一家好的企业关注的是最核心的投入。

sentences.en: So for us, what are the core inputs that are the most critical?
sentences.zh: 那么对我们来说，最关键的核心投入是什么？

sentences.en: Are our members actually getting what they came here for?
sentences.zh: 我们的会员真的得到了他们来这里想要的东西吗？

sentences.en: And that question stopped being asked for too long.
sentences.zh: 而这个问题被忽视太久了。

sentences.en: We were chasing growth.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在追逐增长。

sentences.en: And so when you chase growth, you get it, but then you lose it.
sentences.zh: 所以当你追逐增长时，你得到了它，但随后你又失去了它。

sentences.en: So I'm interested in this because you're talking about the expectations on the street and investors as one of the reasons why this was a difficult period after this enormous growth during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 我对这一点很感兴趣，因为你提到华尔街和投资者的期望是导致疫情期间巨大增长后出现困难时期的原因之一。

sentences.en: But one of the things that I was thinking about was that you were the age of the average user when you started Tinder and Bumble.
sentences.zh: 但我想到的一件事是，你在创办 Tinder 和 Bumble 时，正是普通用户的年龄。

sentences.en: This was millennials, right?
sentences.zh: 那是千禧一代，对吧？

sentences.en: The apps were new.
sentences.zh: 这些应用程序当时还很新。

sentences.en: We've talked about this.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: But Gen Z grew up with the apps.
sentences.zh: 但 Z 世代是伴随着这些应用程序长大的。

sentences.en: And the data says they are very much over them.
sentences.zh: 数据表明他们已经非常厌倦这些了。

sentences.en: 79% report dating app fatigue.
sentences.zh: 79% 的人报告有约会软件疲劳。

sentences.en: We've seen that dating apps are highly generational.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到约会软件具有很强的代际特征。

sentences.en: OKCupid.
sentences.zh: OKCupid。

sentences.en: It's very different than Bumble.
sentences.zh: 它与 Bumble 非常不同。

sentences.en: That seems challenging to constantly be chasing a new user base.
sentences.zh: 不断追逐新的用户群似乎很有挑战性。

sentences.en: Because this idea of, as you say, your members, and the idea is helping them find love, success obviously means that they no longer need the app.
sentences.zh: 因为正如你所说，你的会员，其理念是帮助他们找到真爱，成功显然意味着他们不再需要这个应用程序。

sentences.en: For me, I have a very different framework here.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我有一个非常不同的框架。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I think the reason Gen Z has abandoned the apps is because they're getting on the apps and they're not seeing who they want to see.
sentences.zh: 我认为 Z 世代放弃这些应用程序的原因是，他们登录后并没有看到他们想看到的人。

sentences.en: And they're feeling two things, which I take full accountability for at Bumble.
sentences.zh: 他们感受到了两件事，对此我在 Bumble 负全部责任。

sentences.en: They're feeling rejected.
sentences.zh: 他们感到被拒绝。

sentences.en: And they're feeling judged.
sentences.zh: 他们感到被评判。

sentences.en: If you look at the way these products were designed.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看这些产品的设计方式。

sentences.en: With the swipe function.
sentences.zh: 带有滑动功能。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But it's not even just swipe.
sentences.zh: 但这不仅仅是滑动的问题。

sentences.en: It's paradox of choice.
sentences.zh: 这是选择的悖论。

sentences.en: It's the volume.
sentences.zh: 这是数量的问题。

sentences.en: It's the scale.
sentences.zh: 这是规模的问题。

sentences.en: Our brains were not engineered to behave like this.
sentences.zh: 我们的大脑并非为了这样运作而设计。

sentences.en: I mean, not that we were engineered.
sentences.zh: 我是说，并不是说我们是被设计出来的。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Who knows.
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢。

sentences.en: But you get where I'm going with this.
sentences.zh: 但你明白我的意思。

sentences.en: We were not born to have this.
sentences.zh: 我们天生不是为了这个而生的。

sentences.en: And this is why social media is changing the brains of children as well.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么社交媒体也在改变儿童的大脑。

sentences.en: This is not natural to humans.
sentences.zh: 这对人类来说是不自然的。

sentences.en: And so.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: So go through 100 people and just swipe left and right.
sentences.zh: 所以浏览 100 个人，然后只是向左或向右滑动。

sentences.en: So again, I'm being very vulnerable and very accountable here by telling you these things.
sentences.zh: 所以再次声明，我在这里非常坦诚，并承担责任，告诉你这些事情。

sentences.en: And I'm bringing you into the sausage making of how we're doing things differently.
sentences.zh: 我正在带你了解我们如何以不同方式做事的幕后过程。

sentences.en: Gen Z doesn't like dating apps, in my opinion, because they get on the app.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，Z 世代不喜欢约会软件，因为他们登录后，

sentences.en: They essentially have to judge people and reject people in order to get to a match.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上必须评判别人并拒绝别人才能获得匹配。

sentences.en: You're saying no.
sentences.zh: 你在说不。

sentences.en: You're looking at someone and determining if they're a yes or a no.
sentences.zh: 你在审视某人并决定他们是“是”还是“否”。

sentences.en: So you are judging someone.
sentences.zh: 所以你在评判某人。

sentences.en: That means you're being judged on the back end.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你在后台也被评判。

sentences.en: None of those things feel good.
sentences.zh: 这些感觉都不好。

sentences.en: I think that Gen Z is fatigued and burnt out on feeling bad.
sentences.zh: 我认为 Z 世代对这种糟糕的感觉感到疲惫和倦怠。

sentences.en: And I think they do prioritize mental health more so than maybe the first round of Bumble members.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为他们确实比第一批 Bumble 会员更优先考虑心理健康。

sentences.en: And so the way the app is functioning for them right now, it's not going to work.
sentences.zh: 所以目前应用程序为他们运作的方式是行不通的。

sentences.en: Not only that, but they have to swipe through.
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他们还必须滑动浏览。

sentences.en: You said it yourself.
sentences.zh: 你自己也说了。

sentences.en: Let's just use 100 as an example.
sentences.zh: 我们以 100 为例。

sentences.en: 100 people.
What is the average?
sentences.zh: 平均数是多少？

sentences.en: So that is a private number.
sentences.zh: 这是一个私密数字。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I would love to tell you, but unfortunately, that's not something as a public company, we don't disclose it.
sentences.zh: 我很想告诉你，但不幸的是，作为一家上市公司，我们不披露这个数字。

sentences.en: I'm using 100 as a random hypothetical number.
sentences.zh: 我只是用 100 作为一个随机的假设数字。

sentences.en: If they have to swipe through 100 people to get maybe, you know, one or two matches that they're looking for, do you think that that's a productive experience?
sentences.zh: 如果他们必须滑动浏览 100 个人才能获得也许，你知道，一两个他们正在寻找的匹配对象，你认为这是一种高效的体验吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: That's why I have to reimagine it.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我必须重新构想它。

sentences.en: I want to linger on this idea of what actually makes a successful company for Bumble.
sentences.zh: 我想继续探讨关于什么才是 Bumble 成功企业的想法。

sentences.en: Because if it's not user engagement and keeping people on the app and it's not having a big user base, then how do you monetize this?
sentences.zh: 因为如果不是用户参与度、不是让人们留在应用程序上，也不是拥有庞大的用户群，那么你如何从中获利？

sentences.en: I mean, because it sounds great in theory, but you're also a business that has to actually give a return on investment.
sentences.zh: 我是说，因为理论上听起来不错，但你也是一家必须真正提供投资回报的企业。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So I'm certainly not saying that we don't care about retention and we don't care about engagement.
sentences.zh: 所以我当然不是说我们不关心留存率，也不关心参与度。

sentences.en: My point is, if you look at a social network, TikTok, for example, people are spending like
sentences.zh: 我的观点是，如果你看看社交网络，比如 TikTok，人们每天花费大约

sentences.en: 10 hours a day on TikTok.
sentences.zh: 10 个小时在 TikTok 上。

sentences.en: If you were spending 10 hours a day on Bumble, we would be doing our job the wrong way.
sentences.zh: 如果你每天花 10 个小时在 Bumble 上，那我们就是以错误的方式在工作。

sentences.en: Because the goal is to get you to a match, to get you to conversation, to get you on a date.
sentences.zh: 因为目标是让你获得匹配，让你开始对话，让你去约会。

sentences.en: So what I'm getting at is retention does very much matter for us.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要表达的是，留存率对我们来说确实非常重要。

sentences.en: Are people coming?
sentences.zh: 人们来了吗？

sentences.en: Are they getting into good, healthy conversations?
sentences.zh: 他们是否进入了良好、健康的对话中？

sentences.en: The more quality member base we have, and when I say quality, I don't mean elite standards.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有的会员基础质量越高——当我说是质量时，我指的不是精英标准。

sentences.en: I don't mean beauty.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是美貌。

sentences.en: I don't mean, you know, there's some of these apps out there that have been like, if you don't have a job and you don't make this much money a year, you can't be here.
sentences.zh: 我指的不是，你知道，有些应用程序会说，如果你没有工作，一年赚不到这么多钱，你就不能在这里。

sentences.en: All I'm saying is, show up, fill out your profile, have the maximum amount of photos, put your
sentences.zh: 我只是说，展示出来，填写你的个人资料，拥有尽可能多的照片，进行

sentences.en: ID verification in so we know that you are actually who you say you are, and come and engage in a quality way.
sentences.zh: 身份验证，这样我们才知道你确实是你所说的那个人，并以高质量的方式参与进来。

sentences.en: So if you can imagine a hypothetical world where 100% of our member base was that, you want to talk about growth.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你能想象一个假设的世界，我们的会员基础 100% 都是这样，你想谈论增长。

sentences.en: It goes up and to the right if that is achieved.
sentences.zh: 如果实现了这一点，它就会向右上角增长。

sentences.en: I mean, you're quite bullish on AI.
sentences.zh: 我是说，你非常看好人工智能。

sentences.en: I've heard you talk about it.
sentences.zh: 我听你谈论过它。

sentences.en: How are you imagining AI functioning in this next iteration of the app?
sentences.zh: 你是如何想象人工智能在应用程序的下一次迭代中发挥作用的？

sentences.en: Okay, so for example, let's just talk about AI through the lens of safety for a second.
sentences.zh: 好的，例如，让我们先从安全的角度谈谈人工智能。

sentences.en: Let's say we could train AI on thousands of what we perceive as great profiles, and the
sentences.zh: 假设我们可以用成千上万个我们认为很棒的个人资料来训练人工智能，而

sentences.en: AI can get so sophisticated understanding, wow, this person has a thoughtful bio.
sentences.zh: 人工智能可以变得非常复杂，能够理解，哇，这个人有一个深思熟虑的个人简介。

sentences.en: This person does have photos that are not blurry.
sentences.zh: 这个人确实有不模糊的照片。

sentences.en: They're not all group photos.
sentences.zh: 它们不全是合影。

sentences.en: They're not wearing sunglasses.

sentences.en: A lot of people are finding roommates, you know, navigating life stages with that.

sentences.zh: 而是思考，通过技术将人们连接起来，让他们真正遇见可以去爱的人——无论是他们所爱的朋友，还是所爱的浪漫伴侣，这才是未来的方向。

sentences.en: And then ultimately down the road, if we can help people like themselves more, they'll get into better relationships.

sentences.en: So that's, of course, a long-term vision.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是一个长期的愿景。

sentences.en: When you say like themselves more, where do you see Bumble helping with that?
sentences.zh: 当你提到“更爱自己”时，你认为 Bumble 在这方面能提供什么帮助？

sentences.en: Well, I think we're a relationship business.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们经营的是关系。

sentences.en: We're about love.
sentences.zh: 我们致力于爱。

sentences.en: And I find it very hard to believe that people can have healthy love with others if they cannot find a way to have a healthy relationship with themselves.
sentences.zh: 我很难相信，如果一个人无法与自己建立健康的关系，他能与他人拥有健康的爱。

sentences.zh: 现在有太多人处于这种状态。

sentences.en: It was just this black box of, I guess that's just who I am.

sentences.en: And so can you imagine the power of helping members connect through quizzes and better understanding of how they do deal with conflict, how they do communicate when something, you

sentences.zh: 知道，他们能应对被拒绝的情况吗？

sentences.en: How do they react to that and why?
sentences.zh: 他们对此有何反应，为什么？

sentences.en: So this will be an additional part of what Bumble would offer where you can have a sort of self-exploratory journey that can help you understand yourself better.
sentences.zh: 所以这将是 Bumble 提供的一项额外服务，你可以进行一种自我探索之旅，帮助你更好地了解自己。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Because it leads to better relationships.

sentences.en: connection, I do wonder how having an AI superintelligence mediating that is actually what people are wanting to spend their time on.
sentences.zh: 我确实怀疑，让一个人工智能超级智能来调解这种连接，真的是人们想要花时间去追求的吗？

sentences.zh: 所以我觉得你我的想法其实并没有太大分歧。

sentences.zh: 我想和有情商、有心、能理解我的人交谈。

sentences.en: However, where I do think AI is unbelievably beneficial and I've seen it with my own eyes, I've seen
sentences.zh: 然而，在人工智能确实极其有益的地方——我亲眼见过，我见过

sentences.zh: 演示，见过工作流程——它在压缩和总结信息方面的能力，

sentences.en: I've never seen before.
sentences.zh: 是我从未见过的。

sentences.en: That is objectively factual.
sentences.zh: 这是客观事实。

sentences.en: So if you were to build towards a future where you do have the human matchmaker and you do have the human dating coach at your fingertips through our product, that's great.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你能构建一个未来，让我们通过产品就能随时获得人类媒人和人类约会教练的服务，那太棒了。

sentences.en: But if you can find a way to use AI to read your profile and to extrapolate different learnings
sentences.zh: 但如果你能找到一种方法，利用人工智能阅读你的个人资料，并从中推断出不同的信息，

sentences.en: from you, like loves weekends in the countryside, loves to be outdoors, huge hiker, very into nature,

sentences.zh: 人工智能在这些方面非常出色，它可以学习对方的模式。

sentences.en: What it can do is it can then scan thousands of profiles, if not more, and it can say, hey, you know what?
sentences.zh: 它可以做的是扫描成千上万甚至更多的个人资料，然后说，嘿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: I mean.

sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么，我就是滑了。

sentences.en: So serendipity will take on a life of its own.
sentences.zh: 所以缘分自有其生命力。

sentences.en: However, what I will say is that I think opposites attract, but opposite values don't attract.
sentences.zh: 不过，我想说的是，我认为异性相吸，但价值观不同的人是不会相吸的。

sentences.en: I'm a firm believer of this.
sentences.zh: 我对此深信不疑。

sentences.en: You can be completely opposite.
sentences.zh: 你们可以完全相反。

sentences.en: You can like sweets and they can let, they hate sweets.

sentences.zh: 我个人从未见过一对价值观不合的伴侣能长久走下去。

sentences.zh: 我们会与非常有经验的治疗师和关系专家合作，设计出精美的问卷，我们目前正在进行这项工作。

sentences.en: And if you go and speak to a couples therapist, they will tell you the 10 books that they have used with thousands of couples throughout their, their career.

sentences.zh: 为什么我们不借鉴那些关于什么真正驱动兼容性、爱和健康关系的经验，先帮你了解自己，从而更好地帮你找到你想要的东西呢？
